page.client259013GuidanceConfigurationGa: Client 2.59.0.13 guidance configuration, gate loading, prediction and guidance consumers were checked offline. This uses proportional-navigation kinematics with configured gains and command limits to compare three explicit short-term maneuvers at constant speeds. Full PID, aerodynamics, thrust, climb programs, target scintillation, multipath, terrain and fuzes are not reproduced.
page.closestApproachBelongsOnlyToThisSim: Closest approach belongs only to this simplified scenario, not an actual miss distance or survival probability. Observation interruption and recovery are user assumptions. Being inside a search window does not guarantee reacquisition; being outside does not imply all guidance ends. Beaming can coexist with a stable collision course.
page.theNativeDetectionPathIncludesGroun: The native detection path includes ground response as a separate denominator term. With other terms equal, weaker clutter can make target retention easier; the beam is not an unconditional lock-break switch. Complete ground geometry has not been reconstructed, so lock-loss probability is not calculated.
page.highAltitudeDefenseRequiresEarlyCha: High-altitude defense requires early changes to closing conditions; a terminal turn cold may be too late.
page.ito90MZa35FilteringReferenceNotActu: ItO 90M / ZA-35 filtering reference, not actual interception probability.

page.combinedConfiguredMassWindowsCover8: Combined configured mass windows cover 80–3500 kg. There are no corresponding entries below 80 kg or above 3500 kg. page.weaponsWithoutGuidanceComponentsAre: Weapons without guidance components are excluded from this active-interception branch. Ordinary unguided bombs warrant direct testing; instances have not been verified for every weapon. BLU-27 (401.4 kg) lacks guidance while GBU-8 (1027 kg) has TV guidance. Both are within the mass window, so mass alone cannot determine eligibility. A small-diameter label is also insufficient.
page.gbu39Gbu53AndSpice250FallWithin: GBU-39, GBU-53 and SPICE 250 fall within these mass ranges; 50 kg Brimstone is outside the priority windows of these two configurations. A mass range is not an interception probability.
page.doesASteepAttackFromAboveHelp: Does a steep attack from above help?
page.staticMaximumLauncherElevationIs80F: Static maximum launcher elevation is 80° for ItO and 81° for ZA-35. Near-zenith approaches warrant testing but are not confirmed AI no-fire zones. Angle depends on each defense position; missiles already launched and other positions may still intercept.
page.nativeAiAlsoFiltersTargetsByWhether: Native AI also filters targets by whether their trajectory threatens the position. No universal release-altitude immunity switch was found. A guaranteed safe altitude cannot be recommended.
page.canStandoffLowAltitudeOrSaturationG: Can standoff, low altitude or saturation guarantee penetration?
page.terrainMaskingStandoffAndReducedAir: Terrain masking, standoff and reduced aircraft exposure can manage risk, but do not prove ammunition cannot be intercepted. Priority, reaction time and overlapping positions affect outcomes. No same-version evidence supports a fixed salvo size or penetration probability.
page.countsAboveAreEffectiveHitsNeededFo: Counts above are effective hits needed for the required damage. Sorties assume all hits and exclude interception, misses and airfield regeneration.
page.dataComesFrom259013EcAirfield: Data comes from 2.59.0.13 EC airfield mission templates, ItO 90M / ZA-35 configurations and native filtering functions. It is a versioned reference, not live battle data. Compared with 2.57.1.89, mass and speed windows already existed; explicit reaction times were added. The entire ruleset is not new. Template coordinates do not establish that defense positions were raised in this update.
page.theLatterSSmallAmmunitionExceptions: . The latter's small-ammunition exceptions and low-altitude rules apply to Nuclear Escalation, not automatically to Simulator EC.
page.parametersComeFromOneClientDatasetM: Parameters come from one client dataset. Mechanic explanations use official references; community questions are not treated as formulas.

page.affectsAirfieldModuleRecoveryRegene: Affects airfield module recovery; regeneration matters during sustained attacks.
page.hitTheRelevantModuleAnAirfieldIsNot: Hit the relevant module; an airfield is not one shared HP pool. Select a specific module above for its HP bracket and weapon count. This page does not know the remaining HP in your battle.
page.whyDoEqualTntMassesRequireDifferent: Why do equal TNT masses require different weapon counts?
page.thisPageUsesWeaponSpecificMissionDa: This page uses weapon-specific mission damage and EC target HP. Nominal TNT equivalence is not a universal weapon-count chart. Target type, room maximum BR, ammunition and burn-out criteria change the result. Community Air RB charts cannot be applied directly to Simulator EC.
page.officialForumDiscussionOfModesAndOl: Official forum discussion of modes and old charts
page.doesACcrpCueGuaranteeAHit: Does a CCRP cue guarantee a hit?
page.checkTheSelectedWeaponSalvoQuantity: Check the selected weapon, salvo quantity and target point. Map markers, mission targets and cockpit markers may differ. Follow in-game target confirmation and the native release process.
page.bomanaS8111EstimateCannotFullyRepro: Bomana's 8111 estimate cannot fully reproduce game guidance, occlusion or terminal impacts. Missing TAS or terrain prevents a reliable release decision; available envelopes are references only.

page.whenMaintainersRefreshBomanaParamet: When maintainers refresh Bomana parameters, aircraft, weapons, HP and this catalog are generated and validated together, then published with the website. The header shows the actual source version. Game hotfixes are not reflected instantly. Static damage and fuel planning must be distinguished from battle outcomes.

optimizer.keepsMultimodeWeaponsWithSatel: Excludes laser/optical stores without satellite guidance, including imaging IR. Keeps satellite-capable multimode weapons; unguided bombs and rockets are unaffected.
optimizer.simpleLoadoutHint: Prefer fewer weapon types with similar delivery characteristics. May reduce rewards; keeps selected stores.
page.baseModeHint.respawning: Standard respawning bases and Sim; also used by some newer Arcade maps. Excludes the special Dover reinforcement rules.
page.baseModeHint.legacy_rb: Non-respawning bases: usually 3 at low BR, 4 from 5.0. Assumes one spawn; actual base count depends on the map.
page.baseModeHint.legacy_ab: Arcade HP multipliers for non-respawning bases. For newer respawning maps, choose New respawning bases (all modes).
optimizer.allowedStoresHelp: Right / green allows this category; left / gray excludes it. Click anywhere on the item to switch. Manually selected stations stay equipped.
optimizer.guidanceHelp: The selector synchronizes category switches: Any restores all, Guided excludes unguided categories, and Unguided disables missiles and all four guidance families. Editing a switch updates the selector. Multimode weapons need one allowed mode; unknown families cannot bypass exclusions. Manual command guidance means steering the weapon, excluding SACLOS and optical target retargeting.
optimizer.guidancePreference: Within the accepted reward band, prefer GNSS and allow optical weapons to complete damage. Compare actual releases and designation workload before reducing weapon types. TV remains eligible; no aircraft-specific rules are used.
optimizer.balancedHelp: At coefficients ≥ {{floor}}, prefer easier delivery plans, then fewer weapon types. Otherwise maximize yield.
optimizer.strictRewardHelp: Maximize the coefficient, then prefer simpler loadouts for exact ties.
optimizer.uniformHelp: Prioritize consistent delivery and fewer weapon types, even at lower yield. Keep manual selections.
optimizer.simplerNearCap: Coefficient {{chosen}} versus {{maximum}} with yield priority; favoring easier delivery.
app.baseBurnoutHp: Burn-out at {{remaining}} HP remaining · {{damage}} HP damage needed
page.allHitsAssumption: Damage assumes every weapon hits. The reward coefficient is not actual SL or RP.
page.moduleScope: Uses EC airfield / helicopter target parameters. Airfield modules start at full HP with no regeneration; every weapon is assumed to hit.
optimizer.guidedOnlyHelp: Automatic recommendations use confirmed guided stores only. Category switches still apply; manually fixed stations and required pods stay equipped, with warnings for filter conflicts.
optimizer.noFeasibleWithFilters: No feasible loadout with these ammunition filters. Relax the filters and try again.
currentLoadout.fixedPreset: This preset has no matching station rules; calculations use the complete preset.

simScore.objectiveHelp: Strictly maximize estimated full-load score for the same target remaining HP and room BR. Equal-score candidates found prefer fewer delivery profiles and weapon types, then less excess damage and mass. Reward preferences never reduce the score objective.
simScore.noRecommendation: No confirmed score recommendation under these constraints. Check legal loadouts and known damage / multiplier parameters, or continue searching.

simScore.scoreUpper: Estimated score upper bound: {{score}}; highest score not yet proved. Continue searching.
simScore.maximumUnproved: Highest estimated score is not yet proved. Continue searching.

optimizer.targetInvalid: Enter a positive whole number of bases.
optimizer.lockedGuidanceConflict: Retained manual stations contain excluded stores: {{stores}}. Automatic additions still follow the filter.
optimizer.customHelp: Meet the desired count first, then compare covered bases × whole-loadout coefficient. Spare capacity earns no additional reward. Equal reward prefers less surplus damage, then mass. The uniform-loadout preference still applies.
optimizer.unguidedHelp: Unguided only automatically selects stores explicitly classified as unguided. Unknown classifications are excluded. Conflicting manual locks are retained and shown.
simScore.moduleEstimate: Empirical estimate capped at remaining module HP; assumes all hits and complete burn, excluding regeneration.
simScore.modelScope: Empirical estimate; accuracy in other conditions is unknown. Other rewards excluded.
